name: Flux Thorvaldsdóttir
role: Evidence removal and scene sanitation — cleaner
location: The Narrows — cramped residential corridors between megastructures, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Liora Mori-Sefa is slight and easy to overlook, which is exactly the point. At 45, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He taught himself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know him best. He works as a cleaner out of The Narrows, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Liora Mori-Sefa operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
psychology.secret: Liora Mori-Sefa murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
example_lines: "I make problems disappear. The mess is temporary. The clean is permanent."
"There was never anyone here. There was never anything here. Are we clear?"
"Forensics is a conversation between evidence and investigators. I end that conversation."

story_hooks: A crew member from Liora Mori-Sefa's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Liora Mori-Sefa discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
Liora Mori-Sefa is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Liora Mori-Sefa is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When he makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of his stories.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Geneware muscle density treatment — looks natural, hits like chrome
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.
affiliation: Semi-independent — recurring contracts with mid-tier fixers

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Northern European dominant (48.1%) with significant Hispanic/Latin American (23.2%) and Sub-Saharan African (15.0%) ancestry, plus smaller admixtures of Central Asian (7.3%), East Asian (3.4%), and North African (3.0%). The result is a phenotype that defies easy categorization — Northern European bone structure tempered by Latin American warmth and African undertones, creating a genuinely mixed-heritage appearance that reflects the Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Lean and economical, deceptively compact. Geneware muscle density treatment gives his frame a corded, efficient quality — no excess, all functional. Moves like someone who has learned to take impact without broadcasting it.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, threaded with premature silver at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight, practical. Kept short enough not to interfere with work.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm mid-to-golden brown with complex undertones — Northern European paleness blended with Latin American and African warmth creating an even, sophisticated tone without harsh contrasts
physical_description.complexion: Fine-featured, angular face with high cheekbones and a narrow jaw reflecting Northern European structure softened by broader features inherited from Latin American and African ancestry. Skin is weathered but meticulously maintained — the grooming of someone who understands that invisibility requires not looking neglected. No facial hair. Small white scar through left eyebrow, clean edge. Two thin parallel scars on right cheekbone, deliberately preserved rather than removed.
distinguishing_marks: White surgical scar running through left eyebrow, approximately 2cm, edge clean
Two parallel scars on right cheekbone beneath eye, each roughly 1.5cm, deliberate preservation suggests they serve as personal marks or reminders
Faint burn marks on left inner wrist, barely visible, old enough to be nearly healed
Small tattoo on inside of right forearm near smartgun link — geometric pattern, private placement
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — visible as a raised port array beneath the skin with faint neural interface scarring. The chrome is polished stainless, no attempt to conceal it. Geneware muscle density treatment is invisible but evident in the way muscle definition appears without obvious bulk — functional rather than aesthetic augmentation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Still. Conserves motion. Walks with minimal upper body movement, lets hips lead. Stands in corners when stationary, back always positioned with sightline control. Doesn't fidget. His stillness is his primary invisibility asset — easier to overlook someone who isn't performing visibility.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian. Charcoal gray tech-weave utility jacket with reinforced forearm panels — practical, worn enough to be invisible but maintained. Black cargo pants with custom pockets. Steel-toed boots, scuffed but functional. Thin high-neck undershirt in black, covers any subdermal scarring. No branding visible. Everything selected for silence — no rustling fabrics, muted colors, nothing that broadcasts presence. The overall effect is someone designed to be forgotten.
